notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.notes:

notes.title: Announcement: Spawn System Overhaul and Highscore Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Keepers!

We’ve been blown away by the incredible skill and perseverance of our community—many of you have surpassed the highest nights we ever expected in the game! However, this has revealed an unexpected issue: after Night 80, the spawn rate mechanics caused fewer enemies to appear, unintentionally decreasing the difficulty instead of increasing it.

We will roll out some significant changes to address this and ensure the game remains challenging and fun:

What’s Changed:
Minimum Spawn Period: Enemies will now spawn at highest every 0.5 seconds.
Night 51+ Adjustments: Enemies won’t spawn faster after Night 51 but will increase in difficulty by scaling hp.
HP Scaling: Starting from Night 51, enemy HP will increase by 5 each night.
These changes ensure the game remains challenging after Night 51.

Highscore Updates:
We know how much your highscores mean to you and the community. Removing all highscores would be unfair to those who worked hard to achieve them, but leaving unreachable scores up could demoralize new challengers.

Here’s our solution:
Highscore Adjustment Offer:
If you have a highscore above 55 nights and there’s no highscore above yours that’s under 55 nights, you can request us to delete your highscore.
As a token of our gratitude, we’ll reward you with a unique Discord title for your contribution to keeping the leaderboards fair and competitive.
Thank you for your continued support and understanding. Your passion drives us to keep improving the game for everyone. We can’t wait to see the new records you’ll achieve!


Additional Patch Notes
Balance Changes

 Lightning tower hitting players if no enemies present was meant as a fun gimmick. But it caused a lot of new players thinking they found a bug. So we decided to remove it.
 Shop: Increased chances for lower tier items
 Totems that grant secondary damage now stack

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug causing less enemies to be spawned after day 80
 Fixed a bug causing totem shop not showing duplicates in some situations
 Fixed a bug causing some waterbowl colliders to be lower than other items.
 Winter weapons: Fixed t2 double cannons not hitting some enemies
 Fixed a bug causing players to load the game for free rerolls with specific totem combinations
 Fixed a bug causing players to be able to start practice mode while another player carried an item
 Fixed a bug causing players to be able to start practice mode while a gift was shown in shop


Keep being awesome,

Daniel & Daniel

notes.title: Drums of Winter Update : Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Keepers,

Just in time for Christmas we have a little present for you: This is our biggest update for now. This update brings a bunch of exciting changes, including a brand-new weapon run, a unique skin for Next Fest winners, and a major overhaul to bomb mechanics with the introduction of War Drums. We've also refined game balance for 3- and 4-player modes, added quality-of-life improvements, and squashed several pesky bugs.

Whether you’re diving into the new Winter Weapons run, enjoying brighter nights, or exploring the improved crafting systems, there’s something for everyone. As always, your feedback has been invaluable, so thanks a lot for your great feedback and support.

Patch Notes Overview

 New Weapon Run: Introducing Winter Weapons with a unique recipe.
 Exclusive Skin: Winners of Next Fest receive the unique Lion Skin.
 Bomb Mechanics Overhauled: Improved mechanics and strategic options with new War Drums.
 Balancing Tweaks: Significant updates to projectile weapons, Myst & Magic abilities, and 3-4 player scaling.
 Quality of Life Improvements: Enhanced brightness, save slots, better crafting UI, and controller updates.
 Bug Fixes: Resolved critical issues, including rare map errors and controller vibration problems.

Dive into the details below!

Patch Notes
New Content
New Weapon Run: Winter Weapons (Physical Only)
Experience a new weapon type with a completely unique recipe. (No spoilers—try it out!)

Skins for Next Fest Winners
Added the exclusive Lion Skin for winners of the Next Fest Event.

Balancing Updates
New Feature: War Drums

 Bombs no longer skip time.
 War Drums are a new strategic tool that lets players manually skip time and call the next wave.
 Using War Drums increases the gold gain modifier for the current night, scaling with the amount of time skipped.
 Introduced the Drums Party Totem, which rewards gold whenever time is skipped.
 Bomb Party Totem has been removed.

Projectile Weapons

 Fire DOT effects now stack.
 Increased Fire DOT damage:
 Tier 1: From 10 over 5 seconds → 20 over 5 seconds
 Tier 2: From 20 over 10 seconds → 40 over 5 seconds
 Air projectiles now always trigger shock directly instead of only after hitting a shocked enemy, resulting in a significant damage increase and making it easier to understand.

Myst & Magic

 Each new tier now increases loads by 1.
 Hammer:
 Now hits enemies regardless of their position.
 Damage adjusted to 20/30/45/60 (T0/T1/T2/T3).
 Vulcan:
 Starts with 3 loads (previously 2).
 Lightning Tower:
 Damage adjusted to 20/30/45/60 (T0/T1/T2/T3).
 Starts with 4 loads (previously 3).

3 & 4 Player Adjustments

 Overhauled bomb mechanics improve gameplay balance for 3- and 4-player teams, resulting in greater gold gains for larger groups.
 Time bonuses for 4-player teams increased by an additional 10%.


Quality of Life Improvements

 Brightness: Increased night-time brightness for improved visibility. Let us know if it still feels too dark.
 Day/Night Cycle Toggle: Players can disable the cycle, ideal for local co-op on large screens or for improved visibility at night.
 Woodland Keep: Removed the door due to overwhelming feedback.
 Controller Support: Added D-pad support for movement.
 Confirmation Prompts: Added "Are you sure?" messages to Restart and Menu buttons.
 Save Slots: Introduced multiple save slots for player convenience.
 Crafting UI Enhancements:
 Recipe steps are now color-coded for quicker recognition (e.g., smelting icons are now red).
 Added a dynamic crafting recipe system for Sling Weapons: when picking up an item (e.g., an egg), players will see instructions for crafting it (e.g., placing it in a water bowl).


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Vault wouldn't load higher-tier diamonds in Practice Mode.
 Fixed a bug caused by Pushing Firebugs interacting with Combustion Workbenches.
 Resolved a bug where enemies gained max HP when hit by negative damage.
 Addressed an issue where water projectiles could deal negative damage.
 Fixed a rare error on the Quad Garrison map in Practice Mode that led to multiple issues.
 Adjusted configurations to mitigate controller vibration issues:
 Since these are difficult to reproduce, please report any remaining problems, including:
 Controller type.
 Action that triggered the vibration.
 Whether playing in local multiplayer.
 Whether you were the host or a client.



We appreciate your feedback and are dedicated to improving the game with every update. Keep the input coming!

We wish you happy holidays and a Merry Christmas!

Daniel & Daniel

Ps.: Want to talk about strategies, discuss balance and balance changes or learn how to play the game? Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/n24hXgwhaW

notes.title: Patch 5
notes.notes:
Hey Keepers,

The past three weeks have flown by, and we’re genuinely excited by the amazing feedback you’ve shared! The volume of responses has been incredible—so much so that while we can’t reply to everyone individually, please know that we’ve read every single one. Your input has been instrumental in helping us compile a detailed list of changes to address your suggestions.

Our list of ideas continues to grow, and we’re working hard to prioritize the most impactful improvements. Thank you for your support and thoughtful feedback—it’s a privilege to be part of such a passionate community!

This patch focuses primarily on fixes—many of them minor or addressing rare issues—but we wanted to roll these out quickly as we shift our attention toward balance updates, quality-of-life improvements, and exciting new content.

QoL


 The sell station can now be used by multiple helis at the same time. This will result in a lot more helis ;)
 Piles can now be thrown away if you bought a pushing pile of the same type
 Bombs now show “Next Wave” if they skip time to the next wave


Fixes


 Fixed an issue where items where saved while being carried, which can happen if you reroll while another player carries an item. If this happens those items will now be placed near the campfire, to be replaced after loading. This also fixes old saves, where this issue occurred.
 Myst & Magic: Fixed a bug where red and purple where intervened
 Fixed a bug where multiple runic totems could destroy a save file
 Myst & Magic:  Fixed a bug where hardened magic stones did not work once after combining a weapon
 Fixed a bug causing empty shop slots not be shown after practice modes for clients
 Fixed a bug where the day increased after killing all dummies in practice mode
 Fixed a bug where combining broken diamonds could cause visual duplicates if a red heli was programmed to carry diamonds


Thanks again for all the valuable input! We’re committed to making the game even better, one update at a time. If you want to talk to us, discuss strategies and balance or want to keep up to date feel free to join our Discord.

notes.title: Mid Next Fest Demo Update: Shiny New Content
notes.notes:
Next Fest Additional Content!
First of all we want to thank you all for all your amazing support with feedback, big reports, and ideas! 🙌

With that being said there has been some addition content that is being added to the game for all of you to experience during Next Fest! 

NEW MAP
The secondary map, Twin Fortress, can now be unlocked by completing 10 days on Greenwood Keep on the Bam or Kaboom difficulty setting. This will also introduce a new leaderboard and a new mini event. See ⁠🎟community-events for more details.

New Pause Menu Features
Three new features have been added to your Pause Menu!

• First, you will be able to start your practice mode as opposed to running back and forth to the dummy outside. 

• Second, you will be able to check your score! Now you can track your progress while trying to push for those top leaderboard spots.

• Third, you will be able to check the recipes of items! This means no more having to run to a particular item to prompt a recipe! Simply go to the pause screen and look up what you want to make! This can be accomplished if you press (a) on controller or space / enter on keyboard when selecting a recipe. This will also prompt the recipe to be shown in on-screen info bar.

Cannons in the Store
There has been some rework to the store! You can now get regular and double cannons at higher tiers! Now you can upgrade all the store slots and still receive regular and double cannons on Tiers 4 and 5. Reminder: This demo still is capped at tier 4.

Seeded Stores and Totems
The store and totem selections will now be seeded. This will help maintain balance within your runs and keep "cheeses" such as reloading the game to get a more favorable set of options.

Totem Rebalancing
There has been a lot of new balancing and reworking of a lot of the totems! This will change a lot of how things happens on your runs and should unlock a larger array or options for you as the player. Choose different ones, mix and match, and see what you can acomplish!

Speedrunning Is Coming!
The livesplit feature has been added to the game! This will give all of you an official way to start speeding through the days to top the charts on speedrun.com! The category is still currently being setup and authenticated with the website. Initially this will be runs to day 20 on kaboom difficulty. However, there will be more details as the game gets verified and things get balanced.

Additional Fixes
• Bugs that have been found/reported have been fixed
• Rewording to totems descriptions 


That is all for now! We hope you have an amazing weekend enjoying all the new content and fixes that is in this patch! Please don't forget to report any additional bugs you find, share your gameplay feedback, and share all the fun ideas that you have!

Keep up the amazing work, Keepers! 💪

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Keepers,

We are finally ready to announce our long awaited release date: Keep Keepers will release on October 28th!

We published a new trailer to announce this date and showcase a bunch of new content waiting for you in the release version. Have a first look at new maps, new enemies, new furniture and new weapons awaiting you in the full version. Additionally, you can already see all the new possibilities for automating your keep with teleporters, ghost grabbers, 90°-grabbers and more!
Now that we have finished this pre-release trailer, we will focus on finishing the release version. While doing so, the demo will continue to benefit from bugfixes and polishment.

Keep supporting us, we really appreciate it!

Daniel & Daniel

notes.title: Tiny Teams - Demo Feedback Patch
notes.notes:
Greeting Keepers,

We're excited to announce that Keep Keepers is now part of the Tiny Teams Festival! This has brought a wave of new streams, content videos, and, most importantly, a wealth of valuable feedback from our growing community. As always, your input is incredibly important to us, and we're committed to making Keep Keepers the best game it can be.

To celebrate all the attention and support we've received, we're releasing a special patch that incorporates some of the feedback you've shared with us. While we're hard at work on the full version, we wanted to ensure that we implemented as much of your feedback as possible in this update.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait for you to experience these new changes in Keep Keepers!

Patch Notes:


Game Intro:

 We've reworked the starter items to have a base efficiency of 1, with all subsequent items having higher efficiencies. This change makes it easier for new players to grasp the early progression in the shop without needing prior knowledge of the default efficiency of starter items. Additionally, we’ve adjusted all recipes to maintain approximately the same crafting time as before.

 The starter smelter now has a capacity of 2 loads (down from 3), and the regular smelter now holds 3 loads (down from 4).

 Bombs now trigger the next wave of enemies starting from the easy difficulty level and onward. This change is intended to make early rounds quicker and more engaging for experienced players while still giving newer players plenty of time to learn the game.

notes.title: Demo Patch 5: Demo 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello Keepers,

you haven't heard from us in a few weeks, there's a reason for that. We have been working very hard on a new demo upgrade. We have introduced new visuals, new content, a better introduction for new players and new challenges for experienced players. This is our biggest update yet and we think you will have a lot of fun with it.

We can't wait to hear your feedback, so download the patch and give the new demo a try. It will be worth it.


Features


 Introduced Map stages for better player progression → Much easier and less stressful start for beginners and a way more challenging game for experienced players
 New nightmare enemies → Unlock and try the Kaboom mode to find out more
 Advanced crafting options for harder difficulties → Automation got even more interesting
 Added three new totems
 Added storage that can hold up to four small items of the same type
 Camera controller now considers player movement and direction of view


Graphics


 Reworked visual style
 Optimized shader usage for better performance and color consistency
 Moved camera position & FOV to have a better view on all models (also, players aren’t “tilted” anymore)
 Unified textures, lights, sprites, post-processing… to further improve overall color consistency
 Reworked main menu and loading screen
 Added enemy portals → Where are they coming from?
 Added ground textures and details
 Added new mouse cursor


Balancing


 The shop is not completely random anymore. E.g. complex and/or expensive furniture is not shown within the first few days
 Added starter furniture variants for waterbowl, workbench, smelter and bomb workbench
 Smelter needs more time to burn hot iron ingots
 Diamonds spawn faster
 Defensive totem will now always give +250 health regardless of the current palisade health


Polishment


 Doors are 20% larger and have much less resistance
 Added furniture spawn animations for initial furniture, shop items and tutorial furniture
 Added furniture target and place animations during daytime
 Delayed second tutorial hint to avoid overloading player with multiple UI elements at once
 Highlighted additional spawned tutorial objects to indicate next steps more clearly
 Added delay after fight phase before you can start the next night
 Clients now also see an error message when gifts are in the shop and they press “ready”


Fixes


 Fixed enemy counter when killing a bomb while it explodes
 Fixed a bug that caused the smelter to ask for wood during the day, even in the shop
 Fixed King Red attacking too early when being knocked back after throwing his companions
 Fixed water collider near bin
 Fixes barricade health bar display issues
 Fixed practice mode dummy highlight flickering
 Fixed shop rerolling sometimes when using practice mode
 Fixed a bug that prevents double cannon from being saved & loaded
 Fixed a bug that caused the reroll totem to be active after being thrown into the trash
 Fixed a bug that prevented totems from applying extra loads
 Fixed incorrect load display for client when using totems
 Fixed totems not affecting secondary double cannon projectile
 Fixed discount totem price display for clients
 Fixed a bug that was causing late-joining clients to see shop items and totems at the same time
 Fixed description for “Song of Inspiration”-Totem to correctly show 25% efficiency bonus
 Fixed a bug that caused cannons from spawning at the campfire after being thrown into the bin
 Fixed a bug that could cause strange behaviour when placing a bomb
 Fixed several issues that could cause weapons and furniture to stack
 Fixed potential reasons for crashes


Keep looking great

Daniel & Daniel

notes.title: Demo Patch 4: Mighty Totems
notes.notes:
Hello Keepers, 

We're excited to unveil our latest addition to the game! In this latest patch, we are introducing the Totem System, accessible through the all-new Totem Shop.

The Totem Shop will make its debut on Day 4 and will appear every 3 days thereafter, giving players the opportunity to purchase these powerful artefacts. Each totem will grant powerful buffs that will enrich and diversify your gameplay strategies. We're unleashing the first 20 totems with the initial release, providing ample opportunity for experimentation and strategic innovation.

This update not only adds a new level of excitement to the game, but also greatly enhances its replayability. Existing players will be drawn back into the game with new opportunities to explore the possibilities unlocked by these totems.

As we move towards the full release, we're committed to enriching the demo experience with additional content. However, please be aware that future patches may take a little longer as we focus our efforts on creating an expansive and immersive full release.

Now prepare your Keep for the night Keepers and stay tuned for more updates on the horizon!

Features

- The mighty totems - be prepared to explore the first 20 totems and exploit a bunch of new strategies

Fixes

- Fixed a problem where selling did not have an action indicator
- Fixed a race condition that prevented new players from picking up items
- Fixed a bug that was causing dummies to be knocked to the side
- Fixed a bug where dummies were not dropping diamond shards
- Fixed a bug where entering training mode after buying an item would cause the shop to reload.
- Fixed a bug that caused King Red to stand still
- Fixed potential crashes

notes.title: Demo Patch 3: Practice Mode and more
notes.notes:
Hello Keepers, 

we understand that it can be frustrating to get a new weapon and have to try out an element for the very first time, risking a good run and losing because you didn’t know how it works. Therefore, this patch focuses on the new element onboarding experience and adds a practice mode!

In addition to that, we’re working on content for the full release. Some of it will also find its way into the demo. Prepare for the Endless Replayability Fest starting on May 13th :)

Features


 Added a practice mode. You can use it to practice new weapons and furniture and to program these smart grabbers without any pressure from incoming enemies
 The recipe info bar now displays the new recipe when targeting weapon upgrades in the shop


Onboarding


 An additional tutorial goal is added to assist with the first night
 The recipe info bar no longer has a default setting. Instead, it tells you how to use it
 Clears the tutorial workbench indicator for firebugs after destroying all four crystals
 When you buy a new element for the first time, you have to go to a guided practice mode before you can start a “real” night. This gives the opportunity to learn how it works with the new elements and ammunition.


Fixes


 Fixed race condition that caused night to stop too early in rare cases
 Fixed an issue causing air cannons to cause less damage
 Fixed potential crashes


Keep practicing
Daniel & Daniel

notes.title: Demo Patch 2: Better Tutorial
notes.notes:
Hello Keepers!

the last two weeks were extremely exciting for us: Hundreds of new players tried the Keep Keepers demo since our demo release day! Although we improved the game a lot during our internal playtest beforehand, we got A LOT of additional feedback. If you learned about Keep Keepers through a Youtuber or Streamer → they also help us understand what to change in future patches: So please keep supporting them :)

In this patch, we have focused on bugs and crashes, as well as our onboarding experience.
While we probably haven't fixed all the crashes, and we still have a few ideas for improvements to the process, this patch should be a big step in the right direction. The next patch will address the learning experience after the tutorial.

If you have further feedback or ideas, please let us know.

Graphics


 Replaced tool and weapon outlines
 Placeables are no longer drawn over the keep walls
 Screen outlines now scale with screen resolution


Polishment


 Dangerous belaborations get indicated much more clearly now
 Reduced the air weapon sound effect volume
 Workbenches now ask for items that can be crafted
 All furniture now asks for items that can be combined
 Smelter needs a bit longer to create hot iron ingots
 Smelters ask to remove hot cannonballs first, even if they need wood
 Waterbowls will now ask for hot iron ingots if you carry one
 You can no longer take small items out of the bin during the day. They will still be stored for the next night or until you put something else in the bin


Tutorial


 Initial cannon and all bought weapons are fully loaded
 Added an additional first goal to introduce the recipe info bar and hint at an upcoming attack
 Hides sell station at the beginning to avoid confusing new players
 Well spawns together with trees to avoid confusion with water in the first half of the tutorial
 The cannon also costs 40 gold in the tutorial and there are now four crystals
 The bomb indicator encourages new players to hit multiple crystals at once
 Hints explaining smelter & cannon loads will now ALWAYS appear during the tutorial when reloading with pre-existing loads
 Trees no longer glow after cutting the first tree
 Relevant doors in the tutorial will introduce themselves by shaking
 Fixed tutorial goal header “You don’t get any weapons for free” ⇒ “You don’t get your first weapon for free”. Actually, right after the tutorial, the initial weapon, is free
 Added missing X-diamond thought bubbles
 Initial cannon and bin are highlighted after coming out of the tutorial to show that they exist.
 Reduced respawn timer in tutorial to 8 seconds


Fixes


 Fixed conflict between tip of the day (totd) and hints: totd is skipped if hint is currently visible
 Fixed shock damage not applying damage sometimes
 Fixed potential crashes related to item indicators
 Fixed shop tooltips not always displayed
 Fixed element upgrades not being saved when placed in the keep
 Fixed a bug that caused the mouse to be shown after pressing restart
 Fixed a bug that prevented the B button on the controller from closing the invite players screen
 Fixed a bug that sometimes made games unjoinable after loading a save game
 Fixed cooling down iron ingot belaboration - it’s not indicated as “dangerous” anymore
 Fixed water colliders near bridge to prevent players from walking on water
 Fixed client player being able to pickup two items
 Fixed several potential crashes


Keep telling your favorite Streamer about Keep Keepers

Daniel & Daniel

notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News: Keep Keeper Demo Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow gamers!

We're thrilled to announce that the long-awaited demo for Keep Keepers is finally here, and it's available for download right now on Steam! Dive into a world of adventure and excitement as you get a taste of what's to come in our upcoming title.

Here's what you can expect from the Keep Keepers demo:

🔥 Projectile Weapons: Experience the first of at least 6 weapon categories.
🌍 Greenwood Keep: Survive the first fifteen nights in Greenwood Keep and try out different strategies.

🎮 Hunt Highscores: Optimize your strategies and try to beat the top 20 players.

But wait, there's more! We want to hear from you. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to refine and perfect Keep Keepers. Share your thoughts, suggestions, and any bugs you encounter on our community forums. Your input will shape the future of the game!

Ready to keep your keep? Download the demo now and join us on this exciting journey. Don't forget to wishlist & follow Keep Keepers to stay up to date on all the latest news and announcements.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. Together, let's make Keep Keepers an unforgettable gaming experience!

Keep gaming,
Daniel & Daniel
Thunderrock Innovations
